thread.title: All 30 Dow stocks fall ahead of the open - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: All 30 Dow stocks fall ahead of the open - MarketWatch
text:
The premarket selloff in Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -0.44% components is unanimous, with all 30 stocks losing ground, as Dow futures YMZ8, -0.19% tumble 220 points. The biggest decliner is UnitedHealth Group Inc. shares UNH, -0.31% which slumped 2.8%. Just behind was Walgreens Boots Alliance Inc.'s stock WBA, -1.56% which fell 2.4% after the drug store chain reported fiscal fourth-quarter earnings that beat expectations but sales that missed. The most active stocks ahead of the open were Apple Inc.'s AAPL, -1.01% which shed 1.8%, and Microsoft Corp.'s MSFT, +0.41% which lost 1.7%.
